name: ChargeGuard — Demo ingestion errors
message: SYNTHETIC / DEMONSTRATION ONLY. One or more events in the last minute triggers this demo monitor. Investigate service:chargeguard-api env:dev logs and labeled telemetry. Stop injections, submit valid recovery telemetry, then allow the 1-minute counter window to expire. Recovery indicates absence of new events, not physical safety or guaranteed service availability. No notification recipients configured.
